description: **First release: tree-sitter-python v0.25.0 in pure Go.** Translated from [tree-sitter-python v0.25.0](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-python/releases/tag/v0.25.0) (commit 293fdc02038ee2bf0e2e206711b69c90ac0d413f) with github.com/stricttools/wasm-to-go v0.5.0. Requires github.com/cgofree/tree-sitter v0.1.0. Parse trees and query captures are identical to a native C build of the same sources on 1986 inputs (python: 1986, 50 through the API).
